response.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA) as average_ana, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` > '1995-11-09' AND `Examination Date` < '1997-03-17'

assumptions.assumption: The Examination Date column stores dates in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Text comparison of ISO 8601 formatted dates produces correct chronological ordering (e.g., '1995-11-10' > '1995-11-09' lexicographically). This assumption is needed because the schema specifies DATE type but the request explicitly requires text comparison semantics
